In the meeting, one woman was dressed in expensive heels, while the other was dressed in worn-out sneakers. The woman dressed in the expensive heels was telling the other woman the results of her performance reviews and giving her a raise. Who was not the boss?
A. The one who is dressed in worn-out sneakers
B. Can't answer
C. The one who is dressed in expensive heels
